ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the quadrilateral $ABCD$ is inscribed in the circle $\odot O$. If one of its exterior angles $\angle DCE=68^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle BOD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since quadrilateral ABCD is inscribed in circle O,\\
it follows that $\angle A = \angle DCE = 68^\circ$,\\
by the Inscribed Angle Theorem, we find $\angle BOD = 2\angle A = \boxed{136^\circ}$

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a circle, points A, B, C, and D are all on the circle, forming the inscribed quadrilateral ABCD. Point E is on the extension of BC, located to the right of C, therefore ∠DCE is the exterior angle formed by CD and CE. The center of the circle is labeled O, OB and OD are connected in the figure, and what is required is the central angle ∠BOD. Reasoning: Because ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral, an exterior angle of a cyclic quadrilateral is equal to its opposite interior angle, so ∠BAD = ∠DCE = 68°. ∠BAD is the inscribed angle subtending arc BD, while ∠BOD is the central angle subtending the same arc BD. The central angle is equal to 2 times the inscribed angle subtending the same arc, therefore ∠BOD = 2 × 68° = 136°.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram: A, B, C, D lie on circle O, point E lies on the extension of BC past C, and the marked exterior angle is ∠DCE. Use the cyclic quadrilateral exterior-angle theorem: an exterior angle of a cyclic quadrilateral equals the opposite interior angle, so ∠BAD = ∠DCE = 68°. Then ∠BAD is an inscribed angle subtending arc BD. The central angle ∠BOD subtending the same arc is twice the inscribed angle, so ∠BOD = 2 × 68° = 136°.

推理：因为 ABCD 是圆内接四边形，圆内接四边形的一个外角等于它的对内角，所以 ∠BAD = ∠DCE = 68°。∠BAD 是截弧 BD 的圆周角，而 ∠BOD 是截同一弧 BD 的圆心角。圆心角等于同弧所对圆周角的 2 倍，因此 ∠BOD = 2 × 68° = 136°。
